reading.title: The Morning Newspaper
reading.text: Every morning my father buys a newspaper on his way to work. He likes to read it on the bus. Yesterday there was a newspaper article about our school on the front page. The headline said, "Students Plant One Hundred Trees". My father was very proud because I helped plant the trees. He showed the article to his friends at work. Now we keep it at home.

listening.script: My cousin Omar delivers newspapers in the morning. He gets up at five o'clock. He takes a daily newspaper to forty houses. It is a local newspaper, so it has news about our town. After work he reads the front page with a cup of tea. He says the sports article is the best part.
